items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the K-injectivity of property (I) modules: no acyclic module maps to them in the homotopy category (statement lines 2620-2627). The proof (lines 2629-2652) is a complete reduction chain in the span: the filtration triangle with the representable-homological reduction, the finite admissible filtration of the quotients down to products of shifts of the dual, and the terminal computation through the Hom-into-shift-dual lemma and exactness of the dual. H2: the two-step reduction architecture carries the proof and each reduction is verifiable in the span; the lemma underwrites every property-(I) computation in the chapter.
